aggregation: per-source equal-weight paired differences; mean, median, min/max, valid source count and full registered source/job denominators; no best-seed selection
estimands: height/envelope differences including loading wins and reverse costs

evaluation_rule.compactness: height lower, envelope higher; both empty NOT_APPLICABLE; missing nonempty metrics invalidate compactness layer and reject experience
evaluation_rule.hierarchy: first unequal stable completion or volume decides; otherwise count/mass Pareto; only equal loading permits height/envelope Pareto
evaluation_rule.neutral: registered metric equivalence only; not action, box-set or layout identity

failures: all monitor reason/coverage, first stop progress, timeout, cost/usage, latency p50/p95 with n, injection/query/view/body nonempty rates and singleton counts
interpretation: EMPTY_POOL is sampled-pool stop, not infeasibility proof
prediction is static instability, not real collapse
hard-filter zero violations is not selector benefit
equal loaded volume does not prove equal layouts
remaining capacity sum not future loadability
observational trajectory differences not single-choice causal proof
invalid_policy: retain all jobs/categories and reasons in full denominator; no strategy winner label for invalid pair; valid-pair descriptions may be biased, report counts and full-cohort volume delta bounds [-1,1] per missing pair
local_baselines: both fully tabulated for every source; no historical v5/v6 scores mixed into common-protocol pairs
research_question: conditional loading effects of frozen T/E on independent unseen sources; E superiority not required
statistical_unit: connected source component; variants and repeated trajectories nested, never inflate N; single variant/repeat selected

uncertainty.binary_completion: report per-source pairs and rates, no small-N significance claims
uncertainty.implementation_spec: Python random.Random(seed); sorted valid source IDs; choices(ids,k=N) once per draw shared across metrics; quantiles linear at (B-1)*p; N<6 => descriptive range only, CI NOT_ESTIMABLE
uncertainty.limitation: bootstrap exploratory conditional on admitted finite sample, no model stochastic variance estimate; one repeat cannot estimate it
uncertainty.method: 95% percentile bootstrap of independent source means for paired volume/count/mass/height/envelope deltas

whole_order_interpretation: pair same task/dataset/denominators/common contract; different trajectories allowed, no identical per-step pool claim; stable complete first then volume, count/mass then equal-loading compactness
